rules.requirement: Regulated articles include specified berries, fruits, nuts, and vegetables, but exclude products that are canned, dried, or frozen below -17.8 °C (0 °F).
conditions: Moving host produce interstate or from a fruit fly quarantine area.
rules.quote: Certain berries, fruits, nuts, and vegetables are regulated articles for one or more species of fruit fly unless the berries, fruits, nuts, or vegetables are canned, dried, or frozen below −17.8 °C (0 °F).

rules.requirement: Soil is regulated if it lies within the dripline of a host plant listed on the USDA APHIS fruit fly web page and marked with an asterisk.
conditions: Soil located within the dripline of an asterisk-annotated host plant in a quarantined area.
rules.quote: Soil is a regulated article if it is within the dripline of a regulated article that is listed at www.aphis.usda.gov/aphis/ourfocus/planthealth/plant-pest-and-disease-programs/pests-and-diseases/fruit-flies/fruit-flies-home and that is annotated with an asterisk.

rules.requirement: Harvested Hass avocados must be stored in containers marked with the orchard location and transported to a packinghouse within 3 hours or otherwise protected from infestation.
conditions: When Hass avocados grown or packed in a quarantine area are moved.
rules.quote: Harvested Hass avocados must be placed in field boxes or containers of field boxes that are marked to show the location of the orchard.

rules.requirement: Packinghouses inside a quarantine area packing Hass avocados must fit all exterior openings with screening no larger than 1.6 mm or use an equivalent insect barrier.
conditions: Packing Hass avocados within a quarantine facility.
rules.quote: All openings to the outside of the packinghouse must be covered by screening with openings of not more than 1.6 mm or by some other barrier that prevents insects from entering the packinghouse.

rules.requirement: Regulated articles passing through a quarantine zone must travel inside an enclosed vehicle or be completely covered to prevent access by fruit flies.
conditions: Moving regulated articles through a quarantine area.
rules.quote: The regulated article will be moved through the quarantined area in an enclosed vehicle or will be completely enclosed by a covering adequate to prevent access by fruit flies;

rules.requirement: Entities growing, handling, or transporting regulated commodities may enter into compliance agreements to certify movement once approved by an inspector.
conditions: Entities operating in or moving commodities from quarantine areas.
rules.quote: Any person engaged in growing, handling, or moving regulated articles may enter into a compliance agreement when an inspector determines that the person is aware of this subpart, agrees to comply with its provisions, and agrees to comply with all the provisions contained in the compliance agreement.

rules.requirement: Commercially grown host produce within the quarantine area cannot be moved at wholesale unless treated in an approved manner, safeguarded during transit, and certified by agricultural officials.
conditions: Wholesale movement of commercial host commodities produced in the quarantine area.
rules.quote: At the wholesale level, articles and commodities covered which have been commercially produced within the area under quarantine are prohibited movement from or within the area under quarantine except in accordance with the following provisions:

rules.requirement: Establishments operating inside the quarantine area must maintain host produce at all times under conditions approved to prevent exposure to Mexican fruit fly.
conditions: Handling, selling, or offering host produce at wholesale or retail inside quarantine.
rules.quote: Within the area under quarantine, no wholesale or retail establishment shall handle, sell or offer for sale any article or commodity covered unless such commodities at all times are maintained in a manner approved by the Secretary to preclude exposure to Mexican fruit fly.

rules.requirement: Selling or holding host commodities for sale from trucks, trailers, or mobile vehicles inside the quarantine zone is prohibited.
conditions: Sales or holding of host produce from mobile vehicles inside the quarantine zone.
rules.quote: No commodity covered shall be held for sale or sold from a truck, trailer, or other mobile vehicle.

rules.requirement: Host commodities may be moved outside the quarantine area for processing under a compliance agreement provided appropriate safeguards and waste management practices are implemented.
conditions: Transporting host commodities to off-site facilities for processing.
rules.quote: If appropriate safeguards can be implemented, host commodities may be moved under compliance agreement for processing outside the quarantined area.

ambiguities.topic: Regulation of non-frozen processed forms like pulp or juice
ambiguities.explanation: Federal rules explicitly exempt fruits and vegetables that are canned, dried, or frozen below -17.8 °C (0 °F), but state processing guidelines note that host commodities moved for processing (such as grinding) require compliance agreements. It is unclear whether unfrozen processed items like fresh fruit pulp or unpasteurized liquid juice are exempt or require compliance agreements during local movement.
ambiguities.quote: Certain berries, fruits, nuts, and vegetables are regulated articles for one or more species of fruit fly unless the berries, fruits, nuts, or vegetables are canned, dried, or frozen below −17.8 °C (0 °F).

ambiguities.topic: State vs federal applicability of specific Hass avocado packinghouse physical requirements
ambiguities.explanation: Federal regulations detail specific physical requirements (such as double doors and 1.6 mm screening) for interstate movement of Hass avocados, whereas state quarantine regulations (CCR 3417) require general maintenance to preclude exposure without explicitly stating if the federal structural packinghouse standards apply to purely intrastate shipments.
